title.narrative: Advance gender equality through social system strengthening in Wajir County

description.narrative: This project aims to advance gender equality and change the negative community perception that negates gender equality through community awareness, capacity building and economic empowerment of women and girls. Gender justice is considered as human right that is protected under the Kenyan constitution. In Wajir county key impediments to gender justice include retrogressive negative social norms, poverty, illiteracy, corruption and inadequate vibrant advocacy structures to advocate for gender equality. Through this project worthy Vision will support a series of interventions including the stakeholders meeting to deliberate the rising cases of gender based violence in the county, community education forums to educate the community members on the negative impact of gender based violence, training of local community structures to help create a sustainable network of individuals who champion gender equality at the grass root level, training of local women networks and women leaders to equip them with information and knowledge to support gender justice and economic empowerment support for women especially those operating small scale enterprises in hard to reach and marginalized areas in the county. Education of community members on the negative impact of gender-based violence, the retrogressive cultures and the importance of women empowerment both socially, economically and politically will result to improved perception on gender equality and social inclusive engagements thus leading to gender justice. On the other hand, if women are economically empowered through direct economic support and linkages to resources and opportunities, they will be able to stand against discriminations and inequalities thus leading to gender justice. Building the capacity of grassroot level advocacy structures and duty bearers is vital and sustainable strategy to promote gender equality and make gender justice a reality.
